build_reward_decoder: build a RewardDecoder with a given feature dimension to predict rewards from observation features
run_reward_decoder_forward: run a forward pass through the RewardDecoder trunk network on input feature tensors
get_last_shared_layers: get the last shared linear layer from the RewardDecoder trunk for weight sharing
review_reward_decoder_architecture: review the RewardDecoder MLP architecture with LayerNorm and ReLU activation layers
refactor_reward_decoder_trunk: refactor the RewardDecoder trunk network to change hidden dimension or add layers
